hebrewText: וַ/יֻּגַּד֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י בָרַ֖ח הָ/עָ֑ם וַ֠/יֵּהָפֵךְ לְבַ֨ב פַּרְעֹ֤ה וַ/עֲבָדָי/ו֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יֹּֽאמרוּ֙ מַה זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֔ינוּ כִּֽי שִׁלַּ֥חְנוּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/עָבְדֵֽ/נוּ

tokens.bdb: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
tokens.kjv: bewray, [idiom] certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, [idiom] fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, [idiom] surely, tell, utter.
tokens.explanation: nagad — anunciar, declarar, dizer, contar, revelar

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.
tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
tokens.kjv: Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.
tokens.explanation: Mitsrayim — Egito. A terra das "duas margens" do Nilo

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
tokens.kjv: chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot.
tokens.explanation: to bolt

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
tokens.kjv: [idiom] become, change, come, be converted, give, make (a bed), overthrow (-turn), perverse, retire, tumble, turn (again, aside, back, to the contrary, every way).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.explanation: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to turn about or over; by implication

tokens.bdb: the heart (as the most interior organ);
tokens.kjv: [phrase] bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, [idiom] unawares, understanding.
tokens.explanation: the heart ;

tokens.bdb: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings
tokens.kjv: Pharaoh.
tokens.explanation: Paroh

tokens.bdb: a servant
tokens.kjv: [idiom] bondage, bondman, (bond-) servant, (man-) servant.
tokens.explanation: eved — servo, escravo, adorador (eved YHWH = servo do Senhor)

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.
tokens.explanation: amar — dizer, falar, declarar, ordenar

tokens.bdb: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
tokens.kjv: how (long, oft, (-soever)), (no-) thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.
tokens.explanation: properly

tokens.bdb: this (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.
tokens.explanation: this

tokens.bdb: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
tokens.kjv: accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, [idiom] certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, [phrase] displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, [phrase] feast, (fight-) ing man, [phrase] finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, [phrase] hinder, hold (a feast), [idiom] indeed, [phrase] be industrious, [phrase] journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, [phrase] officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, [idiom] sacrifice, serve, set, shew, [idiom] sin, spend, [idiom] surely, take, [idiom] thoroughly, trim, [idiom] very, [phrase] vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use.
tokens.explanation: asah — fazer, realizar, executar, praticar, produzir

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
tokens.explanation: shalach — enviar, mandar, despachar, estender a mão

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] be, keep in bondage, be bondmen, bond-service, compel, do, dress, ear, execute, [phrase] husbandman, keep, labour(-ing man, bring to pass, (cause to, make to) serve(-ing, self), (be, become) servant(-s), do (use) service, till(-er), transgress (from margin), (set a) work, be wrought, worshipper,
tokens.explanation: avad — trabalhar, servir, adorar, ser escravo de algo
